content.markdown: `KindColoring = FlatKindColoring | ThemedKindColoring`. A current themed palette has complete `light` and `dark` variants, each with `stroke` and `background`. A complete flat pair remains a runtime compatibility input and applies to both themes. `KindColoringVariant` owns the two scalar fields; they are not top-level fields of every KindColoring. Mixed flat/themed records or incomplete theme variants are rejected by `resolveKindColoring`. This workspace authors complete theme variants.
